unit: H34 — the translation of a signed imaging report

The report stays as it was signed. Only.ar: يبقى التقرير كما وُقِّع. تُضاف ترجمته الإنجليزية فقط، باسمك ووقت الإضافة.
The report stays as it was signed. Only.en: The report stays as it was signed. Only its English is added, with your name and the time.
The report stays as it was signed. Only.fr: Le compte rendu reste tel qu'il a été signé. Seul son anglais est ajouté, avec votre nom et l'heure.

A translation is added to a signed repor.ar: تُضاف الترجمة إلى تقرير موقَّع؛ قبل التوقيع اكتب الإنجليزية في التقرير نفسه
A translation is added to a signed repor.en: A translation is added to a signed report; before signing, write the English in the report
A translation is added to a signed repor.fr: Une traduction s'ajoute à un compte rendu signé ; avant la signature, écrivez l'anglais dans le compte rendu

Write the English findings or impression.en: Write the English findings or impression
Write the English findings or impression.fr: Écrivez les constatations ou la conclusion en anglais
